key_insight: The paper introduces ConfSeq, a conformation description language that lets language models understand and generate 3D molecular structures. This bridges natural-language-style AI with molecular conformation tasks such as conformer prediction and 3D molecular generation.
problem_solved: AI models often struggle to represent and manipulate molecules in three dimensions in a way that is both accurate and usable for language models. This work addresses the gap between 3D molecular geometry and sequence-based AI systems.
method: Designs ConfSeq, a text-like language that encodes molecular conformations for language-model processing.
Uses the language to support 3D molecular tasks including conformer prediction, 3D generation, and molecular representation.
Demonstrates strong performance, showing that LLM-style models can be adapted to handle 3D structural chemistry effectively.
impact: For AI/ML practitioners, this provides a new representation layer that makes 3D molecular reasoning more accessible to language models. It could simplify building unified models for chemistry, structure prediction, and generative design.

paper_title: Bridging three-dimensional molecular structures and artificial intelligence with a conformation description language
paper_authors: Jiacheng Xiong, Yuqi Shi, Min Wu, Panpan Shao, Zhaokun Wang
